title_original: Amazon in discussions to film Bond 26 at UK’s Pinewood Studios
excerpt_original: “We’re talking to Amazon” says Pinewood corporate affairs director Andrew M. Smith.

blocks.text: Amazon MGM Studios is in discussions with Pinewood Studios about filming the 26 th James Bond film at the UK st udio.

“We’re talking to Amazon,” said Andrew M. Smith, corporate affairs director at Pinewood Group, speaking on a panel titled ‘Where The World Shoots Next: The New Map of Film Infrastructure’ at Doha Film Festival’s Doha Industry Days.

“Fingers crossed,” added Smith. The executive noted that 23 of the previous 25 James Bond films have been shot at Pinewood, describing the studios as “the home of Bond.” He added that he was “thrilled” that the announcement of Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond had been made, earlier this week.

The 26th Bond film is aiming to shoot next year, directed by Denis Villeneuve and written by Steven Knight. David Heyman and Amy Pascal will produce, taking over from longtime producers Eon Productions.
